title: 55_Thanksgiving

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you been in an earthquake before?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven and I are fine, Mom. We were just going on a walk. You know, to make sure we're hungry for dinner and everything.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Oh good. I'm glad you weren't caught in a dangerous place or on the wrong side of town or anything.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course not, Mom. Raven and I are great. We'll be home as soon as we can. Love you! Bye!
Denni hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just in time. My phone's running out of batteries. It probably would've freaked Mom out more if the phone died on her.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Wow, your phone's dead already?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've been playing this awesome game... `Cause of Death!` I really want to find out who the killer is!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've been playing this awesome game... [color=#3b78e2][i]Cause of Death![/i][/color] I really want to find out who the killer is!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You've been playing that since Halloween! Well, I'm glad you're having fun. Come on, let's get going.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, Mom, we wanted to get some last-minute things for our Thanksgiving dinner, and we kind of went across town.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: But the earthquake!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's okay. We were in a train, so it wasn't `that` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's okay. We were in a train, so it wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: You were in a train during an earthquake?! Do you know what happens on trains?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Here she goes...

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Earthquake or not, you and Raven really shouldn't be wandering around downtown Centerscore in the middle of Thanksgiving! It's a dangerous world out there, and I just think it would be so much `safer` if...
nodes.text_bbcode: Earthquake or not, you and Raven really shouldn't be wandering around downtown Centerscore in the middle of Thanksgiving! It's a dangerous world out there, and I just think it would be so much [color=#3b78e2][i]safer[/i][/color] if...

nodes.text: Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: And be sure to wash your hands whenever you cross the street...
Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: And you should definitely `never` slap a bear, especially a wild one...
nodes.text_bbcode: And you should definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] slap a bear, especially a wild one...

nodes.text: And finally...

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: And in the event of a zombie apocalypse, `never`...
nodes.text_bbcode: And in the event of a zombie apocalypse, [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: Denni's phone beeps.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, Mom, I'm sorry. My phone's dying. I have to hang up now.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Wait, Denni, Raven! Dad and I are going to pick you up right now. Just tell me where you are, and...
The phone cuts short and dies.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's dead. I've been using my phone a lot to play this really fun game. You know, `Cause of Death?` I've been playing since Halloween. But nevermind that.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's dead. I've been using my phone a lot to play this really fun game. You know, [color=#3b78e2][i]Cause of Death?[/i][/color] I've been playing since Halloween. But nevermind that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mom took forever to hang up on! I'm glad she's okay, but `really`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Mom took forever to hang up on! I'm glad she's okay, but [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: See? What'd I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry, Raven. You were totally right. That phone conversation set us back a lot!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I had no idea there were so many safety rules!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I'm sure she made some of those up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: In the event of a zombie apocalypse?!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Like I said, Denni, parents worry. Come on, let's get going.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The swan still looks great!
Denni and Raven walk into the city.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad we're out of that mess! How are you holding up?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great... Except for that part with the earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: At least it was exciting. Bet you didn't think that you'd be dodging luggage and people on a train for Thanksgiving, did you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, this is more intense than sitting on the couch watching football with our stepdad, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Oh yeah, Mom and Mitch! I hope they're okay.
Just then, Denni's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Ring... Ring...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Denni! Are you okay? The earthquake woke me up, and Mitch said you'd gone out, and I thought something might have happened...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's okay, Mom. I'm fine. And so is Raven.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Raven's with you? Oh, thank goodness. Where are you girls? What happened?
Raven nudges Denni, and Denni puts her hand on the mouthpiece.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: If she asks us where we are, don't tell her.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? Why? She really wants to know.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Here's something I learned about parents while I was at college, Denni. They worry. We don't want to make Mom worry more than she has to.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: So don't tell her we're trekking across the city miles from home after being stuck on a train during an earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Denni? Denni? Are you there? Where did you girls go?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We went...
Denni charges through the train, weaving through the crowd while keeping the swan protected.
Five minutes later, on the train platform...
Raven helps Denni jump down from the train window, swan in arms.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Good job, Denni! Let's head out.
An hour later, on the train platform...
Raven helps Denni disembark, swan in arms.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That's good, but we lost an hour in that train! Was it really necessary to go through everyone's bag twice?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Sorry, Denni. You were right. We should've gone through the back. We barely have any time now to make it home for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's okay. We'll figure it out. Let's just focus on getting home.
Denni tries to get through the train but is shoved left and right by passengers with luggage and other items!
Five minutes later, Raven jumps from the back window to the platform.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Okay, Denni, just throw it here and jump down, and we'll be fine.
Denni throws the swan at her sister as she jumps. Raven drops the swan!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven! It lost a wing!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Sorry. At least we didn't waste any time getting off the train though. Let's just focus on getting home.
An hour later, at the door to the train...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Excuse me! Girl with a bird here!
Denni tries to muscle her way through the crowd to get to her sister, but a passenger squashes up against the bird in her arms!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It lost a wing!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Great. Our swan lost a wing, and we lost an hour. Come on, Denni. Let's just focus on getting home.
Denni and Raven walk to the front where a large group of people jostle Raven and Denni from all sides.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven, it's getting too crowded here!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Just look for openings and push through. And make sure you protect the swan!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Did you trade your common sense for those purple highlights?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now you're just starting to sound like Mom. Come on! This way will be better, I promise.
Raven and Denni try to push through the crowd, but passengers jostle Raven and Denni back.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just look for openings and push through. And make sure you protect the swan!
The shaking subsides, and the train comes to a stop.
The girls slump against the wall of the train in relief.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whew! Made it. Looks like the bird did too.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Great. Let's get out of here.
The shaking and the train stop, and the girls slump against the wall of the train in relief.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ow, I fell way too many times. I hope the swan's okay.
Raven and Denni lift the foil to check on the bird.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It still `looks` like a swan.
nodes.text_bbcode: It still [color=#3b78e2][i]looks[/i][/color] like a swan.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Great, Denni, just great. Way to keep it safe.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, it's not my fault we were trapped in a train in the middle of an earthquake! You try keeping this thing `safe.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, it's not my fault we were trapped in a train in the middle of an earthquake! You try keeping this thing [color=#3b78e2][i]safe.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Look, try not to fall on it too much, and let's get off the train.
As the train stops, a loudspeaker blares, ordering everyone to the front of the train to disembark!
The girls look at the front and see a large crowd of people gathering there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven, I don't think we should go through the front. We'll be stuck!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Where else would we go?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Out the back window.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, I know I'm normally the non-conformist here, but...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You want us to jump out the `back window of a train?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want us to jump out the [color=#3b78e2][i]back window of a train?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I want us to jump out the back window of a `not moving` train. Raven, we can go to the front and wait for every panicked passenger to get off...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I want us to jump out the back window of a [color=#3b78e2][i]not moving[/i][/color] train. Raven, we can go to the front and wait for every panicked passenger to get off...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or we can go through the back window, skip the line, and get this cranberry swan home in time for Mom to wake up.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Going through the front is better for the swan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We should go through the...
Denni jumps over the spill, and Raven jumps after her.
Denni and Raven stumble their way to the train wall.
Denni slips in the puddle and falls on her back.
The swan flies into the air and lands a couple feet away.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine. A little sore. A little sticky. But fine.
Raven helps Denni up. They pick up the swan and find their way to the wall.
Denni pitches forward, landing partially on the swan!
Raven falls on top of her.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven! Get off!
The girls scramble to their feet and keep going, but not before the earthquake knocks over an entire tray of glasses.
Water, soda, coffee, and cups spill into the aisle!
Denni grabs the handrail with her free hand and avoids pitching forward. Behind her, Raven trips, and Denni steadies her.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Thanks, sis. But keep going!
Raven and Denni make their way forward, but not before the earthquake knocks over an entire tray of glasses.
Water, soda, coffee, and cups spill into the aisle!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Careful!
Denni dodges the falling suitcase!
Denni and Raven make their way through the train when it jolts again!
Denni freezes! The luggage falls and lands on her foot. Denni drops the swan!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Look out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Owww!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You couldn't have warned me sooner?!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's not like I predicted that was going to happen.
Denni picks up the swan and makes her way through the train when it jolts again!
Denni and Raven hop onto the train and squeeze their way into the train's dining car.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Wow, it's so crowded in here! I wish we had a seat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A seat? I'd settle for a handrail. It's hard enough keeping my balance and juggling this cranberry swan at the same time.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Sure you don't want me to carry the swan?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Please, I'm not five anymore, Raven. I've outgrown throwing things on the floor. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: All right. I trust you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks for coming with me Raven. I think this cranberry swan's going to make Mom really happy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All we have to do is get home on time...
Suddenly, the train trembles and begins to shake violently! Passengers fall in the aisle, and suitcases tumble from the shelves!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni? Are you okay? Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine. Except for maybe the luggage cart on my foot. Raven, what's happening?!
The train starts shaking again!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Earthquake! Come on, Denni! We'll get crushed if we stay in the middle of the train.
Denni and Raven try to get to the wall of the train when suddenly a suitcase falls off the top shelf right above Denni!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It has chai tea frosting!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And it's organic too! Awesome!
Denni picks out the cupcake and puts it in her basket.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't wait to eat this...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's organic too!
Denni picks out the wrapped slice of zucchini bread and puts it in her basket.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't wait to eat this...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's organic too!
Denni picks up the molasses ginger cookie and puts it in her basket.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't wait to eat this...
Raven comes up with scones in hand.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Need anything else?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I think we're done... Oh!
In the display window of the deli, Denni suddenly sees a beautiful swan sculpted out of cranberry sauce!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven, we have to get that swan. Mom `loves` swans! If we had that, it would make this Thanksgiving dinner perfect. I'm sure it would make Mom feel well enough to get out of bed.
nodes.text_bbcode: Raven, we have to get that swan. Mom [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] swans! If we had that, it would make this Thanksgiving dinner perfect. I'm sure it would make Mom feel well enough to get out of bed.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Let's do it.
Denni walks up to the counter.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Excuse me? How much for the swan in the window?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Swan? We don't have any swan. There's turkey, ham, salami, pepperoni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I don't want the meat. I'm vegetarian.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: We have fish.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uhm... That's still not vegetarian. But never mind. How much is that cranberry swan?
Denni points at the cranberry swan sitting in the middle of the cured meats.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Uh, I don't think I can sell you that. That's our only one.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But if you were selling it, how much would you sell it for?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: One hundred dollars.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What? That's outrageous!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: It's not outrageous, it's Thanksgiving.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Yeah, Thanksgiving. The time for `giving.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Thanksgiving. The time for [color=#3b78e2][i]giving.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: That's Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A hundred dollars is too much! Maybe I can work out an arragement...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, I don't want it at full price. I just need to look tough and haggle!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Strike a bargain!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So there's no way we can negotiate the price?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: No way. I'm not budging.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I guess we'll just have to buy our cranberry swan somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's too expensive for us. We need it, but not `that` much. And I'm sure your competitor across the street will have better prices on their cranberry sauce.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's too expensive for us. We need it, but not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] much. And I'm sure your competitor across the street will have better prices on their cranberry sauce.

nodes.text: Denni and Raven walk away.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Wait, girls!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: I'm sure my manager won't mind if we discount it a little. It's almost time for closing anyway.
Denni pays the clerk half the price of the swan!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I knew my little sister was smart.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you going to compose a poem about it? Come on!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, sir, we `need` that swan. My sister and I came all this way for cranberry sauce, and that's the only batch left.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, sir, we [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] that swan. My sister and I came all this way for cranberry sauce, and that's the only batch left.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: And if you need it badly enough, you can pay for it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But it's for our sick mom! Can't we negotiate the price?

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: It's one hundred dollars.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How do I haggle again? Offer different prices, and he'll go lower?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We could pay that... Or I can offer... Eighty!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: One hundred.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: One hundred and ten!

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Uhm. Okay. Sold!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, what are you doing? That's `more` than he wanted before!
nodes.text_bbcode: Denni, what are you doing? That's [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] than he wanted before!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was... Haggling?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Ugh. Nevermind. Just pay him before you offer more!
Denni pays the clerk one hundred and ten dollars.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: We'd better take `real` good care of this swan.
nodes.text_bbcode: We'd better take [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] good care of this swan.

nodes.text: The clerk starts wrapping the cranberry swan in foil.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Could you put that in a box? We have a long journey home, and we don't want it to get crushed.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Sorry, lady, there's been a lot of customers here for last minute shopping. We don't have any more boxes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We'll just make sure it doesn't bump into anything.

nodes.speaker: Clerk
nodes.text: Here you go! Enjoy.
Denni takes the swan.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Do you want me to carry that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, I've got it.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Just be careful.
Denni and Raven pay for their groceries and leave the store.

nodes.title: Denni and Raven's Thanksgiving
nodes.subtitle: Get Denni and Raven home in time for Thanksgiving!

nodes.text: Buy 'The New Girl' mega pack at 50% off to meet $ZOE! Available now in stores!
Welcome back! Today, you'll be playing as Denni, a freshman at Centerscore High.
It's Thanksgiving, and all the families are getting ready for their big turkey feast! Or in the case of Denni's family...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Mom? Mitch? I'm home! Wow, Mom, that turkey smells great.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If by 'turkey', you mean 'tofurkey', and if by 'Mom', you mean 'your adorable, spunky half-sister', then thanks!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni!
Raven and Denni hug.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What are you doing here? Don't you usually spend Thanksgiving with your dad?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, but something came up. So Mom and Mitch offered to let me celebrate with you guys.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad you're here... Especially if you're cooking. Where did all this food come from?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Cans and boxes mostly. I've been slaving away in front of this microwave the entire afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Aw, Denni, you didn't have to do all this. Where is everyone?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mitch is in the den, watching football...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Of course. I'd be surprised if our stepdad ever missed a game.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: But Mom? I'm surprised she let you cook. She usually gets everything from that specialty store she loves. Is she out shopping?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Actually Mom's feeling really sick. She hasn't been able to get out of bed today. She's still sleeping.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That bad? I guess I'll talk to her later. Can I help you with anything then?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Know anything about making a pumpkin pie?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's made with pumpkins?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I forgot about dessert, and that's the thing Mom looks forward to the most.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Why don't we buy it? Let's just go to the store right now! I'm sure dessert would cheer Mom up. Where's my car?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It'll be a total mess to drive today! Especially with all the schools hosting the Thanksgiving Parade. If we're going out, we're taking the train.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Think we can make it in the three hours it'll take to cook the tofurkey?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: If we leave now. Let's go!
After a short train ride...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: All right, Denni, what do you want to get for Mom and Mitch?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll grab the pumpkin pie. Why don't you find some blueberry scones for Mitch?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Perfect! Don't forget to pick something up that you really like. It's your Thanksgiving too!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think I can handle that.
Raven runs off. Denni picks up the pie. She eyes the rest of the delicious desserts on display in the bakery.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow, everything looks so good! But I really want a...
The girls make their way across campus, darting from building to building and hiding when students come close to them.
At last, a large expanse of grass spreads out in front of them. Beyond it lies the gym.
Raven and Denni sprint across the lawn and slip in through one of the gym doors.
The girls lean against the wall, out of breath.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nice running. It's good to know those black boots aren't just for show.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I wear these to mosh in. Of course they're sturdy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I thought you gave up those wild Blood Baby concerts when you went to college.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You kidding? Not a chance.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Exactly! Everything's going to be really cheap.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But don't you think everything will also be picked over? Do you really want everyone's leftovers?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: We're going in.
Raven drags Denni inside the store.
Sometime later, after wading through fake vampire teeth, black make-up, and angry t-shirts...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I found it! I've been looking for these totally cute black fishnet stockings!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We were in here for who knows how long, so you could get `one pair of fishnet stockings?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We were in here for who knows how long, so you could get [color=#3b78e2][i]one pair of fishnet stockings?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's it. I'm putting my foot down. I refuse to be late to dinner over fancy legwear!
Denni drags Raven out of the store.
The girls hurry home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's not a real goth item in there. You don't seriously want to wade through fake vampire teeth, pleather boots, and angry t-shirts, do you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's something a poser would do.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You're... You're right. I don't know what came over me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Besides if you really want a pair of black fishnet stockings, we can always go tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Thanks, Denni.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: So, let's go home! We're almost there.
The girls hurry home...
Raven and Denni walk through a shopping center on their way home when...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Odd Topic is having a sale?! On their Halloween stuff?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's November. Why are they selling Halloween stuff this late?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It must be the leftovers! Let's go look!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven, we can't stop here. We're five minutes away from the house!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Exactly! That's why we can go in.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or we could not go in. Can't we go tomorrow? Weren't you the one that said `I` shouldn't be distracted?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or we could not go in. Can't we go tomorrow? Weren't you the one that said [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] shouldn't be distracted?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: But, Denni, everything's going to be gone by tomorrow. This is the last day of their sale.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What can I say to get her to leave the store alone?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven, look, everything in that store is...

nodes.prompt: Raven, look, everything in that store is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Raven, look, everything in that store is...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Let's go before he changes his mind.
As Skazz enjoys his dessert, the girls leave through the back.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Thanks for giving up your dessert, Denni. I know how much you wanted it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's fine. It was stupid I hesitated. I can't believe I even thought about giving up the swan.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just wanted it so much. Especially after all the trouble we've run into today.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's okay. We're in the home stretch now! Only a shopping center and a couple blocks to go.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Here, take it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Let's go before he changes his mind.
As Skazz enjoys his dessert, Raven drags Denni out the back door.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Sorry, Denni. I owe you one. He just looked so desperate I thought he'd try to take more of our stuff.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's okay. It was stupid I even hesitated. I just wanted it so much. Especially after all the trouble we've run into today.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's okay. But what's this about not getting home? We're in the home stretch now! Only a shopping center and a couple blocks to go.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni! We didn't run around all day babying this swan so that Skazz could eat it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Really, that sounds awesome. You won't believe what they're giving us here.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, give it to him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But, Raven, I... I can't. I was really looking forward to this.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, this isn't even a choice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Skazz, you can have... You can have...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A little dented, but fine. At least it still has its head.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, let's get out of here. We just need to go out that door over there, and we'll be home in no time.
Denni and Raven walk across the basketball court...
When they run into...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What are you Centerscore losers doing here?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait... I recognize you. You're Skazz! You tried to steal Lyle during Spirit Week! Where'd you come from?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I have detention. Violation of 3649. Walking in the hallway at lunch.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You walked down the hall at the wrong time and ended up in detention? On Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I only have eight hours left of my sentence.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But it's almost dinner!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Thanks for reminding me! I just remembered something else too.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: All trespassers are to be reported when immediately spotted and put to work.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on, Skazz. I'm friends with Spike. And last Thanksgiving, he let you eat dinner with him.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Fine. Since I owe that guy a favor...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: All they give us for lunch these days is Riddle Riddle. Give me something good to eat, or I call the Wilson Associate Student Police on you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We have pie or scones...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hate pie. And I don't trust scones.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What kind of person hates pie?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Don't judge me!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What else do you have? Because that swan looks `really` good...
nodes.text_bbcode: What else do you have? Because that swan looks [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] good...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That's for someone else. But there is Denni's treat.
The girls make their way across campus, darting from building to building. At last, a large lawn spreads out in front of them. Beyond it lies the gym.
Raven and Denni start to run across the lawn...
But before they reach the gym, Denni clips a wall, scraping her shoulder and causing part of the swan to go flying!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ahhh!
Several Wilson students turn toward the sound...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey! Who's that over there?! Every student should be on parade clean-up!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, there's no time to go back for it! Run!
Raven and Denni sprint to the gym, burst through the doors, and lock them shut.
The girls lean against the wall, out of breath.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: How is the swan?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: So I was thinking... We don't have a lot of time... We should cut through Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wilson?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Or we walk the entire way around the park and the school to get home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We shouldn't go in, Raven. Wilson's not exactly friendly territory. What if we get caught?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni, the parade is over, and it's Thanksgiving. No one's going to be there. Walking through will be easy. Come on, live a little.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'd rather live a lot.
Raven and Denni walk into Wilson.
...And find members of the student body, marching in straight lines, carrying various parade materials to and from the buildings.
In another section of the school, the cheerleaders diligently clean the work area with mops, brooms, and buckets.
There is no sound except for the sounds of people moving.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What happened to this place? When I went to Centerscore, Wilson students were more... Normal than this.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Brendan was right. When I went on that road trip to visit you at college, Brendan had a strange run-in with one of their administrators.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something weird `is` happening in this school. We should turn back.
nodes.text_bbcode: Something weird [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] happening in this school. We should turn back.

nodes.text: Denni and Raven turn around and see a group of students walking by!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: We're trapped!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Quick! Get down. Let's sneak into their gym. There's an exit out that way.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, you could've spoken up earlier.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But you're right.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I could probably have given them enough scones for their entire family.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: It's too late now. Let's go home before everything we have gets taken, squashed, or smashed.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Here. You can have one slice of pie.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Only one?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: `Chip.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Chip.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I mean, thank you.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks, Denni.
The boys walk away.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You gave them some of the pie?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What else did you want me to do?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Give them the scones. At least Dad's pie wouldn't look half-eaten.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Come on, let's get home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Here. Have some scones. There's enough for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Wow! Thanks, Spike's friend!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're welcome.
The boys walk away happily.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: That was very nice of you. Good thing you didn't give away the pie, or else it would've looked half-eaten by the time it got to Dad.
As Raven and Denni reach the city, they run into two familiar faces.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Spike? Chip? What are you two doing here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Spike ruined Thanksgiving... Again!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The directions said pre-heat to 400! I assumed that meant I had to heat it to 400 degrees again!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You cooked your turkey at 800 degrees?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Why would you think that?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Calm down, guys, I think I know how we can help... We have some extra food.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: What should we give them?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The swan's definitely out. So that leaves pie and scones. Which would be better?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We'll give you some...
In fact, you almost played a perfect game! Don't you want to try again and get the bonus scene?
You might just get to see what some other Centerscore families are doing for their Thanksgivings!
Denni and Raven rush through the front door with their packages to find...
...a dark, empty dining room!
Cold side dishes sit on the kitchen table, and an even colder tofu turkey sits in the middle.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: We're too late.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We missed Thanksgiving.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Denni? Raven?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Girls, is that you?
The lights flicker on, and Denni and Raven see their mom and stepfather come down the stairs.
Cynthia hugs both Denni and Raven.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Welcome back, girls. I'm so happy to see you.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: We were both so worried!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I walked through the neighborhood, and Mitch stopped watching the football game just in case he missed your call.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sorry you had to do that, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Sorry we're late.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: It doesn't matter now. I'm just glad you're home.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Yeah, better late than never.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: We wanted to make sure this Thanksgiving was special, so we brought something home for everyone.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mitch, we brought you some blueberry scones and pumpkin pie.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Thanks! This is really perfect.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And for Mom...
Denni and Raven put the cranberry swan on the table.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Is that cranberry sauce?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I guess we can start Thanksgiving dinner now, though it's a little cold. I hope you don't mind.
Raven and Denni sit, and everyone heaps food onto their plates.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I'm very thankful for all the work you put into dinner today.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Really, Mom, it was mostly Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But it was Raven's idea to go to the store in the first place. And she helped protect the swan.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Well, if it hadn't been for Denni, we might have taken much longer to get home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess what I'm saying is that I'm grateful to have a sister like you.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And I'm thankful I have a sister like you.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: And I'm grateful to have both of you here.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I only have one thing to add to that... Let's eat!
A late start to the Thanksgiving feast, but everything worked out just fine.
You played a good game!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: In the shape of... Well, what is that?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: A football, of course.
Sure. Well, uh, thanks, girls. It's very nice.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: Denni and Raven round the corner onto their street.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You know, it feels like it's been a really long time since we left home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Afraid Mom and Mitch forgot about us?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Ha ha. No, but did you think it would take us this long to get to the store and back?
Denni and Raven walk up their driveway. Raven puts her house key into the lock.
But it doesn't turn!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: My key doesn't fit in the lock anymore!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh. That's weird.
Raven rings the doorbell and knocks on the door until someone opens it.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Yes? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Mom? We're home!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Yes, you're outside a home. But who are you again?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mom, it's us. Denni and Raven... Your daughters?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: My daughters? Oh... Denni? Raven?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes, it's us!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Well, this is awkward.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Awkward?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Since you girls were so late coming home... I adopted some very hungry, very `punctual` children.
nodes.text_bbcode: Since you girls were so late coming home... I adopted some very hungry, very [color=#3b78e2][i]punctual[/i][/color] children.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Adopted?! We were only gone for a couple hours!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But, Mom, we just went to the store. We bought you your favorite cranberry sauce. Shaped like a swan!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: That's nice, but...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Mom! Spike is stealing my turkey leg again!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: As you can see, I'm very busy, and it's Thanksgiving. Please don't come again.
Raven and Denni's mom closes the door!
Through the frosted window, Raven and Denni can see their mom helping Spike and Chip carve a real turkey.
In the background, the football game plays merrily on the television, and Mitch and the boys cheer when a touchdown is scored.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I knew we shouldn't have given those boys our food!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Looks like Mom and Mitch really `did` forget about us...
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like Mom and Mitch really [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] forget about us...

nodes.text: Uh-oh! Raven and Denni replaced by Spike and Chip?! Looks like the girls came home way too late!
Try again and see if you can get Raven and Denni home `in time` for Thanksgiving!
nodes.text_bbcode: Try again and see if you can get Raven and Denni home [b]in time[/b] for Thanksgiving!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: Denni and Raven round the corner...
And find themselves staring down a barren wasteland!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, where are we? I thought this was our home, but now I'm not even sure it's our neighborhood!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I thought we were going the right way.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Did we get turned around?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: After the Goth Emporium, I was following you!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: But after Wilson, I was following you!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Weren't you paying attention?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you saying this is my fault? I didn't see you tracking where we were.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Well, now that I think about it, we don't actually live `near` The Goth Emporium.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, now that I think about it, we don't actually live [color=#3b78e2][i]near[/i][/color] The Goth Emporium.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great, Raven.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess I'm sorry too. But all the apologies in the world aren't going to get us home.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You're right. Let's just backtrack. We'll retrace our steps. It shouldn't be that hard... Right?
And so, the two girls traveled across the barren wasteland, though urban jungles, and across foreign schools, trying to find their way home.
Weeks later, Denni and Raven sit against the wall of the all-too-familiar Goth Emporium.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We've been traveling for weeks now, and we keep coming back to this place. I don't think I can go on much longer.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And I'm so hungry... Can you hand me the last slice of the cranberry swan?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: But I was saving that for me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You had the last bite of the pumpkin pie!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And you took the last scone, so I say we're even.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Raven...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Denni...
Suddenly Denni pounces on Raven, and the two girls struggle for the last bit of food on their long journey.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That leg is `mine`!!!
nodes.text_bbcode: That leg is [color=#3b78e2][i]mine[/i][/color]!!!

nodes.text: Raven and Denni fighting over the last piece of cranberry swan?! And never finding their way home?! This can't be the right ending!

nodes.text: Bad enough the swan is dented.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't think you can even call it a swan anymore. Just a headless bird.

nodes.text: I can't give up my cupcake!

nodes.text: I'll take a cookie.

nodes.text: I can't give up my zucchini bread.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'll take zucchini bread!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't want a pumpkin spice cupcake with chai tea frosting anyway.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't want a molasses ginger cookie in the shape of a flower anyway.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't want zucchini bread anyway.
Raven jabs her hand into Denni's shopping bag and throws the cupcake at Skazz.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Especially since our phone call cut off earlier.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: In the shape of a swan! How beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: In the shape of a swan! How beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or at least a half-eaten pie.
Denni and Raven rush through the front door with their packages to find...
...A sumptuous Thanksgiving feast!
Steam rises from several side dishes, and Denni's tofu turkey sits in the center of a festive table.
Around the table, Raven and Denni's mom and Mitch sit.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Looks like you girls are home just in time.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Welcome back.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mom? You're up? You're not sick anymore?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Still under the weather, but I'm feeling much better now.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: And when I came downstairs, I thought you should come home to a set table and a nice dinner for a change.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I don't always get a lot of time to spend with you girls...

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: But both of you are here, so it's a special Thanksgiving.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We think so too, Mom. That's why we went out.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Where have you been? We were worried.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: You could say we've been swanning around.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But mostly, since this is our first Thanksgiving, we brought home something for everyone.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Mitch, we brought you some blueberry scones and pumpkin pie.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Thanks! This is really perfect.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And for Mom...
Denni and Raven put the cranberry swan on the table.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Is that cranberry sauce?

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Raven, Denni, you carried this all the way home? I don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I do... Why don't you two pull up a chair, so we can start?
Raven and Denni sit, and everyone heaps food onto their plates.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I'm very thankful for all the work you put into dinner today.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Really, Mom, it was mostly Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But it was Raven's idea to go to the store in the first place. And she helped protect the swan.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Well, if it hadn't been for Denni, we might have taken much longer to get home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess what I'm saying is that I'm grateful to have a sister like you.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And I'm thankful I have a sister like you.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: And I'm grateful to have both of you here.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I only have one thing to add to that... Let's eat!
Looks like you got Raven and Denni home in time for a delicious Thanksgiving dinner!
You did a great job!
Thankfully, a perfect one! Here's your bonus scene!
Let's check in on other Centerscore families to see how they're spending their Thanksgiving.
At Colt's apartment that night...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, Maddie. It's just you and me tonight, kid. And we are just moments away from the most perfect Thanksgiving ever.
A microwave beeps, and Colt slides out a fast-food dinner tray. He places it next to a matching one on the table.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And here's a special surprise for you.
Colt pops open a bottle of apple juice and slides it over to... His little sister!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Fizzy apple juice? You're the best big brother ever!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Happy Thanksgiving, sis.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Hey, Colt, shouldn't we wait for Mom to get home?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mom... Mom probably won't be home for awhile. So just go ahead and eat.
And at Howard's house that morning...
Kay and Kel, race down the stairs and into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Mom, we want our Thanksgiving harvest waffles!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! Feed us! We want...
Instead of their mother, Horace stands at the stove!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Hey, kids! Who wants flipjacks?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Don't you mean flapjacks?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Flip. Flap. Really, what's the difference if you can't scrape it off the bottom of the skillet? Somebody find me a scapula!
Howard enters the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, I really hope you meant `spatula`, Dad, and it's in the top left drawer.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I really hope you meant [color=#e23b3b][i]spatula[/i][/color], Dad, and it's in the top left drawer.

nodes.text: Kay, Kel, and Howard take their seats at the breakfast table.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey! How come Mom isn't cooking us breakfast?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, Mom makes a really great Thanksgiving-y breakfast.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, well, your mother's just feeling a little sick this morning, so I thought I'd treat you all to my world-famous Pumpkin Pancake Stack!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Then how come Jean-Paul isn't making us French toast?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: He said something about not understanding our crazy, turkey-centered holiday and went to get a crepe.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: So until Jean-Paul gets back or until your mother feels better, you're stuck with me.
Howard suddenly stiffens. His eyes go wide.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second! You said Mom was feeling sick... In the morning... As in `morning sickness...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second! You said Mom was feeling sick... In the morning... As in [color=#e23b3b][i]morning sickness...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Well, that's, um, very astute, Howard, but I'll need to consult with your mother before I can formally confirm or deny that...
Cathy enters the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Howard's Mom
nodes.text: It's okay, Horace. We'd been hoping to keep this as a surprise until tonight, but I guess the secret's out.

nodes.speaker: Howard's Mom
nodes.text: Children, I'm pregnant. And I have a feeling it's a girl!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow! Congratulations, Mom! When's she due?
Horace puts his hand on Cathy's belly.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Well, we're still in the first trimester, so it'll be a while, but...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What?! A baby sister?!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Noooo!
Looks like Kay and Kel have more than just a school break to be thankful for this holiday!
However you celebrate, have a happy Thanksgiving!

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
